content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling digital products online involves more than just listing items on a store – it requires a robust infrastructure that can handle payments, deliver products, and manage customer interactions. When traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted, creators are left with limited options. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks come in, offering a comprehensive solution that includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, creators can build and deploy their own payment-agnostic stores, free from the constraints of traditional payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks lies a modular architecture that comprises a combination of free and paid tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets are used for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 provide file delivery. NOWPayments, a zero-KYC crypto payment gateway, handles automatic on-chain payment verification, with a 0.5% fee. This architecture allows creators to deploy their stores quickly and efficiently, without worrying about the complexities of payment processing and product delivery.
